World of Warcraft: Forever’s Azeroth welcomes new players, longtime adventurers, and everyone who holds a place for it in their hearts but stepped away for any reason. 

But…what IS it? And how is it different from Modern & Classic World of Warcraft?  

Carve a new path when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026.
